citations.quote: The INVALID clause specifies the circumstances under which a data item fails the relation validation stage of the execution of a VALIDATE statement

cases.reason: General format identical. The 2023 row is DOCUMENTED-NON-SUPPORT under the 2023 optional VALIDATE module. 2002 has no such licence: 3.1 requires every normative element of clauses 6-16 and makes only Annex A optional; VALIDATE and its data clauses are in clauses 13 and 14 and are not in the B.3 processor-dependent list. The compiler refuses INVALID WHEN at --std 2002 citing the 2023 licence.
scope-2002: INVALID WHEN condition-1 in a data description entry (VALIDATE relation stage), any section including records under a CD
cases.needs: 2002 requires the INVALID clause and VALIDATE relation validation; the compiler declines it
cases.compiler-at-2002: wrong (known: same decline already reported by q-10 and p-13 for the VALIDATE facility): conformance-suite/wiseowl/cases/13.18.31-INVALID/declined-validate-invalid.cob ("05 WS-A PIC 9(4) INVALID WHEN WS-A = 0.") at --std 2002 -> "error COBOL1708: the INVALID WHEN clause of the §2023:13.16.2 validation-clauses group", rc=65 (E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/op-20261114/read-2002/out/probes-u-52/refuse/declined-validate-invalid-2002.txt); expected acceptance per §2002:13.16.29 and §2002:3.1
flags-answered: target-not-CONFORMS-OK: 2023 licence is the optional VALIDATE module; 2002 makes only Annex A optional (§2002:3.1) and B.3 does not list VALIDATE: no 2002 licence, the decline is a defect
